policy: Nominal anatomical head height 144/512 excludes hair, ears, horns and equipment. Eight playable heroes use disclosed complete side reflections, including Zeke and Luna to preserve combat-walk phase equivalence. Jasmine retains authored sides and left-hand staff ownership.
method: Complete newly painted figures retain their internal anatomical proportions. Only one uniform aspect-preserving scale per direction and whole-figure translation are applied; no independent head, torso or leg transforms. Actual body heights are recorded separately from art targets.
uncertainty: Skull and pelvis hidden by hair/skirt are manual estimates. Head-region registration estimates phase translations, not anatomy. Generation guides are project direction rather than a pose detector or industry tolerance. Nominal targets never guarantee a generated pose; actual source and output remain available for visual inspection.

walk.registration: Reviewed anatomical head region registered to the passing pose; measured sole-band pixels supply only whole-figure translation.
